target.name: T. Rowe Price Retirement I 2005 Fund—I Class through T. Rowe Price Retirement I 2065 Fund—I Class and T. Rowe Price Retirement Balanced I Fund—I Class (the Retirement I Funds)

acquirer.name: T. Rowe Price Retirement Funds, Inc. (Acquiring Funds, e.g. T. Rowe Price Retirement 2005 Fund—I Class)

announcement.quote: We are writing to inform you about reorganizations that will affect investments in T. Rowe Price Retirement I 2005 Fund—I Class, T. Rowe Price Retirement I 2010 Fund—I Class

deals.notes: The excerpts never state whether these funds are exchange-listed or open-end (they mention redemptions and exchanges of fund shares and I Class shares, but never a listing), so both_listed is null. No completion, termination or vote result is stated. The only withdrawal (Form RW, 2024-05-31) withdraws a mistakenly filed duplicate N-14 (File No. 333-279704) and says the registrant intends to refile the tax opinion under File No. 333-274578; it is not a withdrawal of the merger. The excerpted text says the Board may terminate a Plan if a Reorganization has not closed on or before April 16, 2024. The Agreement and Plan of Reorganization is dated June 26, 2023. The excerpts name one pair of series only as a pattern (Retirement I series into corresponding Acquiring Fund series); the individual pairs are not listed.

problems: Excerpts do not show which pairs exist individually, whether the funds are listed, or how the reorganizations ended.
